records.question: How many policies are there in total?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS policy_count FROM policies

records.question: How many customers do we have?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers

records.question: How many brokers are on our panel?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS broker_count FROM brokers

records.question: What is the total number of claims on record?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_claims FROM claims

records.question: What is the total sum insured across all policies?
records.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(sum_insured), 2) AS total_sum_insured FROM policies

records.question: What is the average annual premium per policy?
records.sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(annual_premium), 2) AS avg_annual_premium_per_policy FROM policies

check.note: The question asks for an average (annual premium per policy), so a single grand total is not meaningful for it.

records.question: How many products do we sell in the Commercial line of business?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS commercial_product_count FROM products WHERE line_of_business = 'Commercial'

records.question: List the distinct claim statuses, ignoring differences in capitalisation.
records.sql: SELECT DISTINCT LOWER(status) AS status FROM claims ORDER BY status

records.question: How many policies are there by product?
records.sql: SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, COUNT(po.policy_id) AS policy_count FROM products p LEFT JOIN policies po ON po.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY policy_count DESC, p.product_name

records.question: What is gross written premium by line of business?
records.sql: SELECT pr.line_of_business, ROUND(SUM(p.amount), 2) AS gross_written_premium FROM premiums p JOIN policies po ON p.policy_id = po.policy_id JOIN products pr ON po.product_id = pr.product_id GROUP BY pr.line_of_business ORDER BY gross_written_premium DESC

records.question: What are total claims paid by broker? Show direct business (no broker) as its own row labelled 'Direct'.
records.sql: SELECT COALESCE(b.broker_name, 'Direct') AS broker, ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(c.paid_amount, 0)), 2) AS total_claims_paid FROM claims c JOIN policies p ON c.policy_id = p.policy_id LEFT JOIN brokers b ON p.broker_id = b.broker_id GROUP BY COALESCE(b.broker_name, 'Direct') ORDER BY total_claims_paid DESC

records.question: How many active policies are there per line of business?
records.sql: SELECT pr.line_of_business, COUNT(*) AS active_policy_count FROM policies p JOIN products pr ON p.product_id = pr.product_id WHERE LOWER(p.status) = 'active' GROUP BY pr.line_of_business ORDER BY active_policy_count DESC

records.question: Which 5 brokers wrote the most gross written premium, and how much did each write?
records.sql: SELECT b.broker_id, b.broker_name, ROUND(SUM(pr.amount), 2) AS gross_written_premium FROM premiums pr JOIN policies p ON pr.policy_id = p.policy_id JOIN brokers b ON p.broker_id = b.broker_id GROUP BY b.broker_id, b.broker_name ORDER BY SUM(pr.amount) DESC LIMIT 5

records.question: How many policies were sold direct, with no broker?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS direct_policy_count FROM policies WHERE broker_id IS NULL

records.question: Show the claim count by cause.
records.sql: SELECT cause, COUNT(*) AS claim_count FROM claims GROUP BY cause ORDER BY claim_count DESC, cause

records.question: What is gross written premium from Business customers?
records.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(pr.amount), 2) AS gross_written_premium FROM premiums pr JOIN policies p ON pr.policy_id = p.policy_id JOIN customers c ON p.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.customer_type = 'Business'

records.question: What was gross written premium in calendar year 2024?
records.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) AS gross_written_premium FROM premiums WHERE transaction_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND transaction_date < DATE '2025-01-01'

records.question: What was gross written premium for fiscal year 2025?
records.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) AS gross_written_premium_fy2025 FROM premiums WHERE transaction_date >= DATE '2024-07-01' AND transaction_date <= DATE '2025-06-30'

records.question: Show gross written premium by fiscal year.
records.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN EXTRACT(month FROM transaction_date) >= 7 THEN EXTRACT(year FROM transaction_date) + 1 ELSE EXTRACT(year FROM transaction_date) END AS fiscal_year, ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) AS gross_written_premium FROM premiums GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

records.question: How many claims had a loss date in 2023?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS claim_count FROM claims WHERE loss_date >= DATE '2023-01-01' AND loss_date < DATE '2024-01-01'

records.question: What are claims incurred by calendar year of loss?
records.sql: SELECT EXTRACT(year FROM loss_date) AS loss_year, ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(paid_amount,0) + reserve_amount), 2) AS claims_incurred FROM claims GROUP BY EXTRACT(year FROM loss_date) ORDER BY loss_year

records.question: How many policies started in fiscal year 2024?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS policy_count FROM policies WHERE start_date >= DATE '2023-07-01' AND start_date <= DATE '2024-06-30'

records.question: How much premium was written on 30 June 2024?
records.sql: SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0), 2) AS gross_written_premium FROM premiums WHERE transaction_date = DATE '2024-06-30'

records.question: How many claims were reported more than 30 days after the loss date?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS claim_count FROM claims WHERE reported_date > loss_date + INTERVAL 30 DAY

records.question: What is our overall loss ratio?
records.sql: SELECT ROUND((SELECT SUM(COALESCE(paid_amount,0) + reserve_amount) FROM claims) / (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM premiums), 4) AS loss_ratio

check.note: Loss ratio is a ratio (claims incurred / GWP), so a single grand-total control figure isn't meaningful for it.

records.question: What is the average claim severity?
records.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(paid_amount,0) + reserve_amount) / COUNT(*), 2) AS average_claim_severity FROM claims

records.question: What are total claims incurred for the Motor line of business?

records.question: What is the net amount of all premium reversal transactions?

records.question: What is the overall claim frequency?

records.question: What is the loss ratio by line of business?
records.sql: WITH gwp AS (SELECT p.line_of_business, SUM(pr.amount) AS gwp FROM premiums pr JOIN policies po ON pr.policy_id = po.policy_id JOIN products p ON po.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.line_of_business), inc AS (SELECT p.line_of_business, SUM(COALESCE(c.paid_amount,0) + c.reserve_amount) AS claims_incurred FROM claims c JOIN policies po ON c.policy_id = po.policy_id JOIN products p ON po.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.line_of_business) SELECT COALESCE(g.line_of_business, i.line_of_business) AS line_of_business, ROUND(COALESCE(i.claims_incurred,0),2) AS claims_incurred, ROUND(g.gwp,2) AS gross_written_premium, ROUND(COALESCE(i.claims_incurred,0) / NULLIF(g.gwp,0),4) AS loss_ratio FROM gwp g FULL JOIN inc i ON g.line_of_business = i.line_of_business ORDER BY line_of_business

check.note: Loss ratio is a ratio (claims incurred / GWP), so a single grand-total numeric control is not meaningful for it.
